using System.Threading;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void IOCallback_NoError_DoesNotLogError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger>().Object;
            var semaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(0, 1);
            var errorCode = 0u;
            var numBytes = 123u;

            // Act
            logger.IOCallback(errorCode, numBytes, semaphore);

            // Assert
            // Semaphore should be released
            Assert.True(semaphore.Wait(0));
            // No LogError call since errorCode == 0
            Mock.Get(logger).VerifyNoOtherCalls();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void IOCallback_WithError_LogsErrorMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var logger = mockLogger.Object;
            var semaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(0, 1);
            var errorCode = 123u;
            var numBytes = 456u;
            var expectedErrorMessage = "Test error message";

            // Mock Utility.GetCallbackErrorMessage to return predictable value
            var originalMethod = typeof(Utility).GetMethod("GetCallbackErrorMessage", 
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public);
            
            // Since Utility.GetCallbackErrorMessage is likely static/internal, we'll test the logging behavior directly
            mockLogger.Setup(x => x.LogError(It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((object msg, object[] args) => 
            {
                var format = msg?.ToString();
                return format != null && format.Contains("[ClusterUtils]") && 
                       format.Contains("{errorCode}") && format.Contains("{errorMessage}") &&
                       args.Length == 2 && (uint)args[0] == errorCode;
            }), It.IsAny<object[]>())).Verifiable();

            // Act
            logger.IOCallback(errorCode, numBytes, semaphore);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(x => x.LogError(
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("[ClusterUtils] OverlappedStream GetQueuedCompletionStatus error: {errorCode} msg: {errorMessage}")),
                It.Is<object[]>(args => args.Length == 2 && (uint)args[0] == errorCode)), Times.Once);

            // Semaphore should be released
            Assert.True(semaphore.Wait(0));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void IOCallback_NullLogger_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            ILogger logger = null;
            var semaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(0, 1);
            var errorCode = 123u;
            var numBytes = 456u;

            // Act & Assert
            Assert.SemaphoreReleasedAfterCall(() =>
            {
                logger?.IOCallback(errorCode, numBytes, semaphore);
            }, semaphore);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void IOCallback_AlwaysReleasesSemaphore()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger>().Object;
            var semaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(0, 1);

            // Act - test both error and no-error cases
            logger.IOCallback(0u, 0u, semaphore);
            Assert.True(semaphore.Wait(0)); // Should be released

            semaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(0, 1);
            logger.IOCallback(123u, 456u, semaphore);
            Assert.True(semaphore.Wait(0)); // Should be released regardless of error
        }
    }

    // Helper extension for cleaner semaphore assertions
    public static class SemaphoreAsserts
    {
        public static void SemaphoreReleasedAfterCall(Action action, SemaphoreSlim semaphore)
        {
            action();
            Assert.True(semaphore.Wait(100)); // Small timeout for test reliability
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Moq.Language.Flow;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void IOCallback_WithErrorCodeZero_DoesNotLogError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var logger = mockLogger.Object;
            var semaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(0, 1);
            uint errorCode = 0;
            uint numBytes = 123;

            // Act
            logger.IOCallback(errorCode, numBytes, semaphore);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogError(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object[]>()), Times.Never);
            Assert.True(semaphore.Wait(0));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void IOCallback_WithNonZeroErrorCode_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            mockLogger.Setup(l => l.LogError(
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("[ClusterUtils]") && msg.Contains("GetQueuedCompletionStatus error")),
                It.IsAny<object[]>()
            ));
            var logger = mockLogger.Object;
            var semaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(0, 1);
            uint errorCode = 123;
            uint numBytes = 456;

            // Act
            logger.IOCallback(errorCode, numBytes, semaphore);

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(l => l.LogError(
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("[ClusterUtils]") && msg.Contains("GetQueuedCompletionStatus error")),
                It.Is<object[]>(args => args.Length == 2 && (uint)args[0] == errorCode)
            ), Times.Once);
            Assert.True(semaphore.Wait(0));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void IOCallback_NullLogger_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            ILogger logger = null;
            var semaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(0, 1);
            uint errorCode = 123;
            uint numBytes = 456;

            // Act & Assert
            logger?.IOCallback(errorCode, numBytes, semaphore);
            Assert.True(semaphore.Wait(0));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void IOCallback_AlwaysReleasesSemaphore()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>().Object;
            var semaphoreNoError = new SemaphoreSlim(0, 1);
            var semaphoreError = new SemaphoreSlim(0, 1);

            // Act - no error case
            mockLogger.IOCallback(0u, 0u, semaphoreNoError);
            Assert.True(semaphoreNoError.Wait(0));

            // Act - error case
            mockLogger.IOCallback(123u, 456u, semaphoreError);
            Assert.True(semaphoreError.Wait(0));
        }
    }
}

            var semaphore = new SemaphoreSlim(0, 1);

            uint errorCode = 123;
            uint numBytes = 456;

            // Act & Assert
            IOCallbackMethod.Invoke(null, new object[] { null, errorCode, numBytes, semaphore });
            Assert.True(semaphore.Wait(0));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void IOCallback_AlwaysReleasesSemaphore()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>().Object;
            var semaphoreNoError = new SemaphoreSlim(0, 1);
            var semaphoreError = new SemaphoreSlim(0, 1);

            // Act - no error
            IOCallbackMethod.Invoke(null, new object[] { mockLogger, 0u, 0u, semaphoreNoError });
            Assert.True(semaphoreNoError.Wait(0));

            // Act - error
            IOCallbackMethod.Invoke(null, new object[] { mockLogger, 123u, 456u, semaphoreError });
            Assert.True(semaphoreError.Wait(0));
        }
    }
